title: Ethiopian Mixed Fruit Juice
community: Addis Ababa juice bars — the layered fruit juice
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Multi-Layer Juice — mango, papaya, and avocado juices layered carefully in a tall glass, creating a spectacular orange-to-green gradient. The signature drink of Addis Ababa's juice bar culture — served as an art form, consumed as pure delight.
longDesc: The layered Ethiopian juice is one of Addis Ababa's great food experiences — the juice bar worker who creates a perfect three-layer drink of mango (orange), papaya (light orange), and avocado (green) is a skilled practitioner. Each layer is blended separately and poured carefully to maintain the colour separation.
ingredients: // All with: pinch of cardamom, ice
steps: Blend mango with water, honey, and cardamom until smooth. Pour into tall glass — fills ⅓.
Freeze glass 5 minutes (optional but helps layers stay separate).
Blend papaya with water and honey. Gently pour over the back of a spoon onto the mango layer — fills middle ⅓.
Blend avocado with milk and honey. Gently spoon over the papaya layer — fills top ⅓.
Serve immediately with a straw. Do not stir — the layers are the beauty.
chefTips: Pour each layer over the back of a spoon — this breaks the fall and prevents mixing.
The density difference between the layers keeps them separate: mango (thinner, denser) at the bottom, avocado (thicker, less dense) on top.
Serve immediately and tell guests not to stir — they should enjoy each layer separately.
This is best made to order — it does not wait.
cookingScience: The layering works because of density differences — mango juice (predominantly water with dissolved sugars) is denser than avocado juice (with significant fat content, reducing overall density). Papaya sits in the middle density. Pouring slowly over a spoon reduces the kinetic energy of the stream, preventing mixing.
sustainabilityTips: All three fruits grown in Ethiopia at different altitudes — maximum local sourcing.
servedWith: As the signature Ethiopian juice bar experience
As a unique gift of colour and flavour
storage: Drink immediately — the layers merge within minutes.
healthBenefits: Three fruits provide extraordinary vitamin diversity.
culturalNote: The Ethiopian multi-layer juice is the drink that makes visitors photograph their order before drinking it — the bright orange to pale orange to deep green gradient is one of Addis Ababa's most shared food images. The juice bars of Addis Ababa have developed the layered juice into an art form that is uniquely Ethiopian.
